mapper.select: SELECT r.v_idx, r.s_idx, r.u_idx, r.v_parent_idx, r.v_content, r.v_rating, IFNULL(u.u_name, '알 수 없음') AS u_name, s.s_name, r.v_created_at, r.v_img, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_report rr WHERE rr.v_idx = r.v_idx) AS report_count FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.u_idx = u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = #{bIdx} AND r.v_parent_idx = 0 ORDER BY r.v_idx DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
